title: Contract: Workflow DSL: declarative schema for stages, gates, fan-out, resume and replay
tests_required: Expressibility test over three sampled blueprints, with any inexpressible construct itemized
Determinism clause test: a workflow declared replayable must produce an identical execution plan on two dry-runs

title: License inventory for every direct and transitive dependency
tests_required: control: a fixture whose metadata says MIT and whose LICENSE file is AGPL must be flagged as a declared-versus-actual conflict, not silently resolved to either

title: Gate command-center prose against verification recipes that are measurably wrong on this platform
tests_required: Known-present: the live RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md 'git archive' line must fire before the fix.
Known-absent sentinel: a scratch document with no recipe must score 0 hits.
Use-vs-mention: rules/common/windows-shell.md, which quotes the wrong recipe in order to forbid it, must NOT fire.
Post-fix: the corrected checklist line must be silent while a planted regression re-fires.

title: Third-party replication rehearsal - and separate 'package incomplete' from 'claim refuted'
tests_required: Isolation control: assert the rehearser's environment cannot reach the repository.
Planted incompleteness: remove one input from a package and confirm the rehearsal reports PACKAGE-INCOMPLETE, not CLAIM-REFUTED.
Planted falsity: mutate the claim and confirm the rehearsal reports CLAIM-REFUTED.
Both-states: a complete package on a true claim must report REPRODUCED.

title: Argv-array-only process invocation layer (no command-string concatenation)
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_argv_only.py::test_hostile_filenames_round_trip
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a deliberately concatenated call must be flagged by the lint AND must corrupt the hostile filename, proving both halves detect the same defect
extend tools/glob-argv-guard tests rather than duplicating them

title: Two-directional live-versus-repo drift classifier
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_drift_classifier.py with planted fixtures for all five classes
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a DIVERGED fixture must NOT be classified REPO-AHEAD; a one-directional implementation must fail this case
regression: the 3 measured live-larger rules files must classify as LIVE-AHEAD or DIVERGED, never as REPO-AHEAD

title: Deployed-copy edit interception routing changes back to repo source
tests_required: hooks tests: deployed path warns; live-only path silent; repo path silent
NEGATIVE CONTROL: remove the provenance record and assert the warning disappears (the record, not the path prefix, is the trigger)
the hook must inject, never block (AGENTS.md 6)

title: Plugin conformance validator (the plugin's own contract test)
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_conformance.py (one case per contract, each with a mutation that makes it fail)
PORTABILITY CONTROL: run on Windows and Linux over the same commit and assert identical verdicts
NEGATIVE CONTROL: 6+ deliberate contract violations must each be caught with a distinct code

title: Compatibility diagnostics across client, OS, and shell
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_compat_diagnostics.py (supported cell, unsupported client, unsupported shell, missing interpreter)
CROSS-SHELL CONTROL: assert the report names the shell it was measured from
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a fabricated unsupported cell must produce a remediation string, not an empty field

title: Doctor advisory mapping each failed probe to its exact remediating command
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_doctor_coverage.py::test_every_code_has_a_remediation
tools/plugin/tests/test_doctor_efficacy.py::test_remediation_actually_fixes_the_fixture
NEGATIVE CONTROL: add a new code without a mapping and assert the completeness test goes red

title: CLI exit-code contract with one code per failure class
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_exit_codes.py (one case per class, asserting the exact integer)
CROSS-SHELL CONTROL: identical codes observed from bash and pwsh7
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a command that fails must never exit 0 even when it printed a report

title: Canonical registry index schema extending .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_index_schema.py::test_current_marketplace_json_validates
NEGATIVE CONTROL: 6 mutated indexes (missing owner, bad version, duplicate plugin name, unknown key, empty plugins, wrong type) each fail distinctly
assert no second index file is introduced anywhere in the tree

title: Package identity grammar with reserved, case, and homoglyph collision guards
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_name_grammar.py (valid, reserved, casefold collision, confusable collision, leading/trailing punctuation)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: 'agent-skills-toolchain' (the real existing name) must be accepted
confusable case: Cyrillic 'а' versus Latin 'a' must collide

title: Dependency metadata model with a cycle detector
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_dependency_graph.py (self-cycle, two-node cycle, long cycle, diamond without a cycle)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: an acyclic diamond must NOT be reported as a cycle
optional and peer edges are classified distinctly from required ones

title: Package permission declaration and the install-time permission surface
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_permission_surface.py::test_rendered_set_equals_declared_set
tools/marketplace/tests/test_permission_surface.py::test_declared_set_equals_enforced_set
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a package declaring nothing must render 'no permissions declared', never an empty screen

title: Excessive and unused permission detector (declared versus actually used)
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_permission_analysis.py (excessive, undeclared, exact-match fixtures)
DETECTOR CONTROL: a fixture with a known undeclared network call must be caught before any 'clean' verdict is accepted
NEGATIVE CONTROL: an exact-match fixture reports zero findings in the same run

title: Advisory record and affected-version-range model
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_advisory_ranges.py (below, at-lower-bound, inside, at-fixed, above, prerelease-of-fixed)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: an unaffected sibling version must remain installable while the affected one is flagged
an advisory with an open-ended range must not silently mark every future version affected without saying so

title: Ranking and trust explainability (`why` for any result or decision)
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_explainability.py::test_components_reconstruct_the_score
tools/marketplace/tests/test_explainability.py::test_explanation_tracks_input_changes
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a deny decision must name the exact policy cell, not a generic message

title: Package documentation parity gate (declared surface versus documented surface)
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_docs_parity.py::test_both_direction_sets_are_empty
tools/marketplace/tests/test_docs_commands_run.py::test_every_documented_command_executes
NEGATIVE CONTROL: remove one doc entry and assert the parity test names exactly that command

title: Content-addressed package blob store shared across installs
tests_required: tools/marketplace/tests/test_blob_store.py::test_dedupe_and_refcount
tools/marketplace/tests/test_blob_store.py::test_corrupted_object_is_detected_on_read
NEGATIVE CONTROL: deleting a blob still referenced must be refused

title: Add per-unit model/vendor/role routing that resolves through rails.toml, not a rival table
tests_required: unknown rail name must FAIL validation; a known rail must PASS
mutation: hardcode a vendor default in the resolver and the unknown-rail test must go red

title: Define the deterministic replay log format (event stream to identical plan)
tests_required: record-then-replay yields a byte-identical plan and identical verdicts
mutation: drop one event field and the byte-equality test must go red (proves the field is load-bearing)

title: Port every new spec type to the JS parity package and prove parity mechanically
tests_required: Python and JS emit identical violation-id sets over shared fixtures
planted omission on the JS side must fail parity (both-states control)

title: Implement role extraction with a normalized role vocabulary
tests_required: invented role maps to UNKNOWN (both-states: a known synonym maps correctly)
UNKNOWN rate reported as a computed number

title: Implement the content-addressed artifact cache backend
tests_required: bit-flipped entry detected and refetched (both-states with a clean entry)
cache hit and miss counters are measured, and a stale entry never masks a fixed artifact

title: Participant registry and identity model
tests_required: unit: fingerprint computation stability
negative control: seat the same configuration twice and assert the collision report FIRES

title: Expertise-ranked selector with claimed-vs-demonstrated verification
tests_required: unit: tag matching precision/recall on a labelled fixture
negative control: a bogus expertise claim must be rejected by the probe

title: Blind independent first pass with a submission barrier
tests_required: unit: barrier semantics under a slow participant and a timeout
negative control: open the barrier early and assert the prompt scan FIRES

title: Majority, supermajority, unanimity, quorum and abstention tally engine
tests_required: unit: 24-case tally matrix (threshold x abstention policy x quorum)
negative control: change the abstention policy and assert at least one recorded outcome flips

title: Privacy, retention and persistence policy engine
tests_required: security: planted-secret corpus across 4 encodings
negative control: disable the redactor and assert all 4 forms are found, proving the scanner is not silently passing

title: Role-collapse detector
tests_required: control: collapsed council must FIRE, diverse council must not
negative control: a single-model council with strong role prompts is the hard case - report its classification honestly rather than tuning until it passes

title: Council abort and kill-switch with a safe partial artifact
tests_required: chaos: abort at 20 random points, log parses every time
negative control: strip the aborted label and assert a consumer accepts it as complete

title: Frontmatter load-semantics resolver (always-on vs path-scoped)
tests_required: both-states test: a fixture rule with no frontmatter must resolve ALWAYS-ON and the same file WITH paths:["**/*"] must resolve LAZY. A resolver that returns the same answer for both fails.

title: Explicit NO-CAPABILITY-FITS terminal verdict
tests_required: no-fit corpus must all return NO-CAPABILITY-FITS; a mutation lowering the threshold so a weak match is injected must turn the test red.

title: Repo-versus-live capability presence gap detector
tests_required: detector control: plant one repo-only and one live-only fixture capability; both must appear. A capability present in both must NOT appear.

title: Owner-facing route dry-run CLI
tests_required: CLI contract test: documented flags all parse; a documented example in the help text is executed verbatim by the test (documentation command test).

title: Advisory file-lease manager with renew and expiry
tests_required: expiry test; renew-extends test; advisory test asserting no write is ever refused; negative control asserting an unleased path produces no conflict event.

title: Anthropic-side work-unit adapter (synchronous, typed)
tests_required: permission-boundary test per permission class; timeout test asserting the declared timeout is the one applied, not a default.

title: Worktree-target repository assertion before any write
tests_required: wrong-repo test must refuse the write; right-repo test must permit it (both-states). A worktree with no origin must be refused, not defaulted to allowed.

title: Rollback contract: every mutating install action declares a typed inverse
tests_required: An action declared with no inverse and no IRREVERSIBLE marker must fail schema validation.
An inverse whose target lies outside the recorded creation set must fail validation.
A partial inverse must be forced to declare its residue; omitting the residue field must fail.
Positive control: the full real action inventory must validate cleanly, proving the schema is not so strict that nothing conforms.

title: Determine what makes a package findable and how ranking is computed in extension marketplaces
tests_required: separate documented ranking factors from inferred ones and label each
control: state the proportion of the ranking that is admitted to be undocumented

title: Determine the provenance and licensing obligations for AI-generated blueprint content
tests_required: label each obligation as required-by-terms, required-by-law-somewhere, or proposed-norm
control: at least one item must land in proposed-norm

title: Executable conformance harness and reference oracle for the 12-condition completion predicate
tests_required: test_oracle_has_12_distinguishable_conditions
test_reducer_matches_oracle_on_full_corpus
negative control: a reducer stubbed to return True always must FAIL this harness

title: Silent-in-both-states scanner over the existing detector inventory
tests_required: test_scanner_flags_a_planted_inert_detector
test_scanner_does_not_flag_a_known_good_detector

title: Blob-versus-worktree EOL parity gate (git cat-file, never git archive)
tests_required: test_gate_reads_blob_bytes_not_worktree_bytes
test_lint_flags_git_archive_used_as_a_blob_source
test_release_checklist_recipe_matches_the_gate

title: Encoding and BOM parse matrix
tests_required: test_bom_prefixed_json_is_handled_or_rejected_loudly
test_utf16_input_does_not_silently_parse_as_empty

title: Quick-start examples must run end-to-end against the packaged artifact
tests_required: test_each_quick_start_example_produces_its_documented_artifact
test_each_advanced_example_produces_its_documented_artifact
test_examples_run_against_the_package_not_the_source_tree

title: Mid-phase resume reproduces the uninterrupted downstream artifacts
tests_required: both-states control: an undeclared non-deterministic field must make the byte diff fail, proving the mask is not a blanket
negative control: masking everything must be rejected by a mask-coverage ceiling

title: Child agent processes inherit only allowlisted environment variables
tests_required: detector control: add the canary to the allowlist and confirm it DOES appear, proving the child dump is real
negative control: full inheritance must fail this test

title: The migration guide actually converts a real old-layout fixture, idempotently
tests_required: both-states control: an already-migrated tree is a no-op
fixture provenance: the old-layout fixture must be captured from a real prior release, not synthesized from the migration script

title: Bound the measurement overhead of the harness itself
tests_required: No-op case timing over 100 iterations, distribution reported.
Overhead attribution per stage (setup, oracle, teardown, ledger write).
Ceiling alarm fires when a case is faster than the harness overhead around it.

title: Licence, terms-of-service and legal gate on everything the acquisition lane ingests
tests_required: a source with no discoverable licence must default to the most restrictive treatment (adverse inference), not to permissive
the gate must fire on a planted restrictive-licence artifact before its silence on real artifacts is trusted
attribution-required and rider-restricted sources must produce an explicit obligations record
